description: This file is a C# source code for a web API application using ASP.NET Core and Orleans. It sets up an Orleans-based distributed system with grains, handles HTTP routes for loading, resetting, and adding to a forest-like structure, and defines grain interfaces and implementations for load balancing and fan-out behavior.

classes.name: LoaderGrain
classes.description: Grain implementation handling forest addition and reset logic, tracking reset count and managing child grains.

classes.name: FanOutGrain
classes.description: Grain that implements a fan-out pattern with configurable levels and children, capable of pinging child grains.

classes.name: HardLimitRule
classes.description: Imbalance tolerance rule implementing a simple check for imbalance threshold.

methods.name: AddForest
methods.description: Adds a new forest grain connection by incrementing the forest counter and pinging the corresponding grain.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets internal counters and invokes reset on diagnostics and management grains.

methods.name: GetResetCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times a reset has been invoked.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Recursively pings child grains for health check.
